varieties.name: 33 (Sansan)
varieties.description: Ideal Walnut (Sansan 33) features a thin, hand-crackable shell and a high yield of sweet, light-colored kernels.
Compared to the 33 variety, the 185 walnut has an even thinner, "paper-shell" that can be crushed between your fingers and an even higher kernel yield of up to 68%. A light-colored, sweet kernel.

varieties.name: Xin 2 (Xinjiang 2)
varieties.description: The Xin 2 walnut features an extremely thin shell that can be cracked by hand, yielding up to 67% of a light-colored, sweet kernel with excellent flavor.

varieties.name: Yunnan
varieties.description: The Yunnan walnut features a moderately thin shell that typically requires tools to crack, yielding about 50-55% of a kernel known for its rich, robust flavor and deep golden color.

varieties.name: Xinfu / Xinfeng
varieties.description: Features a thick, hard shell requiring a cracker, with large light-colored sweet kernels and 50-55% kernel yield.

varieties.name: Bold - 40/50
varieties.description: Indian Bold 40/50 raw peanuts are characterized by their large, uniform kernels, mild flavor, high nutritional value, and versatility for roasting, confectionery, or producing premium peanut butter.

varieties.name: Bold - 50/60
varieties.description: Indian raw peanuts of the Bold 50/60 variety are characterized by their large, uniform kernels, mild and sweet flavor, high yield, and versatility for roasting, confectionery, and peanut butter production.

varieties.name: TJ - 40/50
varieties.description: Indian TJ 40/50 raw peanuts are characterized by their large, uniform kernel size, high oleic content for better shelf life, mild flavor, and excellent suitability for roasting, confectionery, and premium peanut butter.

varieties.name: TJ - 50/60
varieties.description: Indian TJ 50/60 raw peanuts are characterized by their large, uniform kernels, high oleic acid content for superior shelf-life, a mild flavor profile, and excellent suitability for roasting, confectionery, and high-quality peanut butter.

varieties.name: Whole-Bold 40/50
varieties.description: Large, uniform kernels with mild, sweet flavor and clean nutty aroma. Ideal for premium snacks and confectionery.

varieties.name: Whole-Bold 50/60
varieties.description: Medium-large, consistent kernels offering rich taste and roasted fragrance. Perfect for peanut butter and food processing.

varieties.name: Whole-Java 40/50
varieties.description: Extra-large selected kernels with delicate flavor and subtle sweet notes. Excellent for chocolate coating and gourmet applications.

varieties.name: Whole-Java 50/60
varieties.description: Premium uniform kernels delivering superior blanching quality and well-balanced nutty profile. Optimal for high-end food manufacturing.

varieties.name: Blanched Splits - Bold 40/50
varieties.description: Premium, large peanut halves from selected Bold kernels, ideal for crunchy peanut butter and high-quality confectionery where a visible nut piece is desired.

varieties.name: Blanched Splits - Bold 50/60
varieties.description: Consistent, medium-large peanut halves offering excellent yield and a rich flavor, perfect for standard food manufacturing, baking, and snacks.
